papers.title: LaFlash: Capacity-Driven Acceleration for Coding Agent Workflows via QLC-HBF
papers.abstract: As large language models (LLMs) evolve toward agentic AI, coding agents are emerging as memory-intensive workloads that repeatedly reuse persistent states, including contexts and KV caches. Emerging agentic workflows, including Loop/Graph Engineering, cause state amplification through frequent active/dormant transitions, increasing memory pressure. Evicted states incur costly recomputation upon reactivation, particularly under long-context, short-decode workloads. This motivates Capacity-Driven Acceleration (CDA), which explicitly accounts for state amplification to allocate memory capacity between active concurrency and dormant-state retention, replacing recomputation with memory access. In this work, we propose LaFlash, a High-Bandwidth Flash (HBF) architecture that exploits the large capacity of Quad-Level Cell (QLC)-based flash to realize CDA. However, QLC's long read latency demands massive read parallelism under irregular state reactivation and varying context lengths, while limited write endurance constrains placement. LaFlash introduces Session Grouping to balance active request counts and aggregate context lengths across groups, sustaining read parallelism and block utilization through request-exclusive allocation. Furthermore, Fast-Page Allocation exploits QLC's read-latency heterogeneity to mitigate residual inter-group imbalance and sustain bandwidth utilization. On end-to-end coding agent workloads, LaFlash achieves 7.04$\times$ higher throughput and 10.96$\times$ higher energy efficiency over SLC-HBF with batch expansion, and 2.36$\times$ higher throughput over QLC-HBF with CDA. HBM buffering further reduces unnecessary NAND writes, improving QLC write endurance. These results demonstrate the benefits of jointly optimizing state retention and physical data placement for capacity-driven acceleration.

papers.title: XM-Sparse: High-Throughput Sparse-Attention LLM Serving over Scale-up Memory Pools
papers.abstract: Sparse attention has been increasingly adopted by production LLMs for long-context inference, yet serving systems must still retain the full KV history, making GPU HBM capacity a key limit on serving concurrency. Existing systems offload the KV cache to host memory, but suffer from the limited bandwidth of PCIe and the limited capacity of host memory. Emerging scale-up memory pools (e.g., X-Mem) relieve both limits and open new opportunities for sparse-attention offloading. In this paper, we first conduct an in-depth analysis and reveal that, even with scale-up memory pools, decode throughput remains bounded by HBM capacity, as hot KV buffers and the fully resident indexer key (K-index) cache occupy substantial HBM. Moreover, the two caches exhibit distinct access patterns. Based on these insights, we present XM-Sparse, the first sparse-attention offloading system over scale-up memory expansion. The core idea of XM-Sparse is to offload both caches aggressively while matching each with an I/O mechanism tailored to its access pattern. Specifically, for dynamically selected KV entries, XM-Sparse fuses TMA-based retrieval with attention in a tile-level pipeline to hide on-demand retrieval latency. For predictable K-index accesses, it prefetches pages via SM-efficient GPU-initiated DMA and coordinates prefetching with latency-critical operations to avoid interfering with decoding. We have implemented XM-Sparse atop SGLang, and our experiments on DeepSeek-V3.2 and GLM-5.3 with an emulated scale-up memory pool show that XM-Sparse delivers up to 4.98$\times$ and 4.52$\times$ higher decode throughput than PCIe-based ECHO and HiSparse, respectively, and up to 1.34$\times$ over a naive integration on the same platform, across 16K-1M contexts.

digest.summaryZh: XM-Sparse 观察到稀疏注意力仍需保存完整 KV 历史，热 KV 与 K-index 继续挤占 HBM。系统将两者卸载到扩展内存池，以融合 TMA 取数处理动态 KV，以 GPU 发起 DMA 预取可预测索引，并协调与解码通信的竞争。
digest.motivationZh: 稀疏注意力减少计算却不消除完整 KV 历史，HBM 中的热 KV 缓冲和常驻索引限制服务批量与解码吞吐。 PCIe 卸载受带宽与主机容量限制；换成扩展内存池后，直接沿用常驻索引和独立换入阶段仍留下 HBM 容量及取数停顿。 只有区分动态 KV 与可预测索引的访问形态，才能把更大内存容量转化为可承受的并发与吞吐。 高度契合长上下文推理、KV 层次、GPU 内存扩展及传输与计算协同。
digest.methodZh: 按访问模式选择传输机制，同时卸载 KV 与 K-index，并将按需取数、注意力和预取调度协同。；先遍历 HBM 命中 tile，用 online softmax 累积注意力以覆盖未命中 KV 的 TMA 取数。；以双缓冲共享内存连接取数、反量化与注意力流水，顺便回填热 KV 缓冲。；GPU 发起 DMA 把 K-index 页预取到可复用 staging 缓冲，在关键注意力和 MoE 通信时让出传输资源。；实现基于 SGLang、修改的 FlashMLA 与 GPU 发起 DMA；评测使用8张 NVIDIA B300，其中4张解码、4张作 X-Mem VM 内存节点，大容量由虚拟映射模拟。；针对 KV 的低延迟随机取数和索引的可预测大流量分设 TMA 与 DMA 路径，避免把扩展内存仅视为朴素换入空间。
digest.experimentsZh: 正文实现与评测部分使用 FP8 DeepSeek-V3.2、GLM-5.3 和16K–1M上下文，扩展内存池为模拟配置。 比较 PCIe 方案 ECHO、HiSparse，以及同平台朴素集成 HiSparse+X-Mem。 摘要报告相对 ECHO、HiSparse 的最高解码吞吐增益分别为4.98倍和4.52倍；相对同平台朴素集成为最高1.34倍。 峰值增益不代表所有上下文与批量；容量扩展由模拟内存池支持，不能把跨平台4倍收益全部归因于内核设计，同平台1.34倍更能隔离系统贡献。

papers.title: Transfer Once, Ask Locally: Compact Audio-Visual Memory for On-Device Question Answering
papers.abstract: Audio-visual question answering on lightweight user devices requires balancing speed, memory usage, privacy, and communication. One approach is to run audio-visual encoders on a server and a lightweight language decoder on the user device, keeping questions local while offloading media encoding. However, transferring and processing the full multimodal representation remains costly. We propose a training-free, query-agnostic token pruning framework that constructs a compact, reusable memory before transmission. We define video spatio-temporal blocks and aligned audio windows as players and estimate their importance through Monte Carlo Shapley valuation. We use an embedding coverage objective that combines query-independent utility with cross-modal redundancy calibration and rewards unimodal diversity through marginal coverage gains. We retain the original token embeddings of high-scoring players under a limited token budget and transfer the resulting memory once for reuse across subsequent local questions. Experiments on Video-MME, Daily-Omni, and Video-Holmes using video-SALMONN 2+ (3B) and video-SALMONN 2 Pro (4B) show that our method achieves the best or tied-best QA accuracy among the compared compression methods across all evaluated settings. On Daily-Omni with video-SALMONN 2+ (3B) at 80\% pruning, our method improves accuracy by 12.86--14.62 percentage points over these methods while achieving the lowest device-side LLM prefill and decoding latency, with up to $1.92\times$ decoding speedup at comparable embedding memory usage.

papers.title: LASH-PAT: Deadlock-Free Adaptive Shortest-Path Routing for Inter-Chiplet Interconnects
papers.abstract: With the slowdown of transistor scaling, chipletbased systems, and in particular chiplet-based wafer-scale integration, have emerged as a promising approach to sustain growth in computing capability per cost for modern processors and accelerators. In recent years, many specialized inter-chiplet interconnect topologies have been proposed. In these topologies, the simple, well-established, and deadlock-free dimension-order routing scheme is not applicable due to its reliance on regular mesh structures. In this work, we study routing in these recently proposed inter-chiplet interconnect topologies by categorizing and evaluating nine deadlock-free routing functions for irregular topologies known from data center networking in this new context. This reveals a trade-off between turn-based routing, which enables path diversity, and layered routing, which ensures shortest-path delivery. To resolve this trade-off, we propose LASH-PAT, a routing function that extends layered shortestpath routing with adaptive path diversity. LASH-PAT supports multiple shortest paths and dynamically selects among them based on local congestion while preserving deadlock freedom. When compared to the best-performing baseline routing function for each combination of topology, traffic pattern, and evaluated metric, LASH-PAT improves throughput by 21.15% and reduces energy per packet by 12.77%, while providing latency comparable to the lowest-latency baseline routing function.

digest.summaryZh: LASH-PAT 为不规则 chiplet 互连联合分层最短路径与多路径自适应选择，以局部拥塞分流，同时约束通道依赖图保持无死锁。BookSim2 仿真显示吞吐与每包能耗优势，比较基线随拓扑、流量和指标分别选取。
digest.motivationZh: 不规则 chiplet 与晶圆级互连无法直接使用依赖规则网格的维序路由，需要兼顾路径长度、拥塞与无死锁保证。 转向限制类路由保留多路径却可能绕路，分层路由有最短路径优势但自适应路径多样性受到限制。 路由选择会影响互连饱和吞吐、延迟和每包能量，是扩展多芯粒处理器与加速器的架构基础。 直接关联 chiplet、片间网络及加速器通信架构；文章本身未验证特定 LLM 应用加速。
digest.methodZh: 离线构造基础路径与附加路径，避免在虚拟通道依赖图中引入环，在线按局部拥塞选择候选下一跳。；修改 Dijkstra，优先选择对依赖图增边更少的基础路由；必要时采用转向限制路由回退。；逐步加入附加路径并细分路径段的层归属，维持虚拟通道依赖的无环性。；路由表提供多个下一跳，在线选择函数依据局部拥塞实现自适应分流。；路由算法面向片间互连，使用 BookSim2 周期精确、flit级模拟；能耗由 Orion3 与通道模型估计，非流片测量。；同时扩充分层路由的路径多样性和路径段到虚拟层的分配自由度，在有限 VC 下兼顾短路径与自适应。

papers.title: Global strong solutions and large-time behavior for the two-dimensional Navier--Stokes--Poisson system with general bulk viscosity
papers.abstract: The global existence and uniqueness of strong solutions to the two-dimensional repulsive Navier--Stokes--Poisson system with general density-dependent bulk viscosity is established for arbitrarily large initial data allowing vacuum. The periodic problem and the Cauchy problem with a positive constant background are treated under a common growth condition on the viscosity primitive. The coefficient class includes every superlinear power law and near-linear laws with logarithmic gains. A density upper bound and low-order estimates, uniform in time and independent of a positive density lower bound, are obtained without an initial acceleration compatibility condition. Exponential relaxation is proved on the torus, and qualitative convergence to equilibrium is established in the whole space under a finite electric energy condition and without spatial moment assumptions. If the initial density vanishes at a point, the vacuum persists and density gradients become unbounded as time tends to infinity.

papers.title: Improving Eddy Detection from Wide-Swath Altimetry with Multimodal Data-Driven Models
papers.abstract: Physically-based eddy detection algorithms usually rely on hard-coded thresholds and constraints that make the detected structures sensitive to small variations in the underlying fields. One way to relax such conditions is the use of machine-learning methodologies that transform the full problem into an optimization process. We present a multimodal, multi-task, data-driven eddy detection framework based on a shallow convolutional U-Net, trained to jointly segment eddy structures and reconstruct the co-located spatial sea surface temperature (SST) anomaly using a dynamically-based reconstruction as target. Two model variants are developed: NADIRnet, trained on conventional nadir altimetry, and SWOTnet, trained through a curriculum that incorporates SWOT-enriched maps. Both models achieve high pixel- and structure-wise detection scores against the ground-truth, with most residual disagreement attributable to boundary placement rather than missed or spurious detections. The coupled SST regression task, enforced through boundary-coupling and gradient-matching loss terms, is shown to sharpen and regularise the detected eddy boundaries. Compared to the dynamically-based reference, both models recover a substantially larger and finer eddy population; notably, SWOTnet's higher-resolution training signal transfers to conventional nadir altimetry thanks to the higher-resolution SST channel, detecting more eddies than a nadir-trained model on the same data. The framework further generalises, even without retraining, to altimetry products and processing levels unseen during training, including SWOT L3 wide-swath retrievals and an independent gridded product. Together with its low computational cost, this framework is thus promising for near-real-time operational deployment and further downstream applications.

papers.title: Learning Grounded Reasoning from Human Gaze
papers.abstract: Human visual reasoning is driven by systematic exploration and extraction of task-relevant visual evidence. Human gaze provides a window into this process, making gaze a useful source of guidance for visually-grounded reasoning in vision-language models (VLMs). However, human gaze also includes noise and redundancies that may transfer poorly to VLMs. In this work, we investigate how human gaze data can be effectively leveraged to improve visual reasoning in VLMs, while maintaining alignment with human behavior. We collect 7,109 human gaze trials from a diverse and challenging set of visual reasoning tasks, and train grounded reasoning models with different forms of gaze guidance. Across evaluations in chart understanding, visual search, and counting, we find that using human gaze as a prior for grounded reasoning consistently outperforms supervision using the full gaze sequence. Based on these findings, we introduce GGR (Gaze-Guided Reasoner), which achieves greater human alignment and more reliable visual grounding while matching or outperforming leading grounded-reasoning baselines in accuracy. Reinforcement learning further improves task accuracy, gaze alignment, and grounding quality despite using no gaze supervision. Behavioral analyses show that gaze supervised models exhibit more visual exploration before arriving at an answer. Our results suggest that the value of human gaze lies in guiding spatial exploration and shaping reasoning behavior without requiring complete imitation of human behavior.

papers.title: Ambient LLMs: Data-Efficient Supervised Fine-tuning via Temperature Matching
papers.abstract: Collecting large-scale, diverse, and high-quality post-training datasets for autoregressive language models is challenging. Consequently, Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) is typically applied to datasets significantly smaller than those used for pre-training, which leads to overfitting and the catastrophic forgetting of the tails of the data distribution. To prevent this collapse, we introduce Ambient SFT, a principled framework for leveraging imperfect predictions to augment the fine-tuning set. In our method, a "frozen" version of the pre-trained model serves as a noisy teacher that the fine-tuned model must match at a coarse level. In particular, we require that the high-temperature versions of the conditional distributions produced by the post-training model should match the high-temperature versions of the pre-training ones. The temperature hyperparameter controls the level of trust in the pre-trained model, with the limit $T\to \infty$ reverting back to regular SFT and $T=1$ to knowledge distillation. We demonstrate that our approach outperforms standard SFT across domain adaptation, instruction-tuning, and reasoning, leading for up to $21\%$ average relative improvement to standard SFT.

digest.summaryZh: Ambient SFT 在监督微调中加入与冻结预训练教师的高温条件分布匹配，以可调信任保留预训练分布信息，缓解小规模微调数据带来的过拟合和遗忘。证据覆盖领域适配、指令及推理任务，属于后训练算法趋势，不是硬件加速方案。
digest.motivationZh: 微调数据远少于预训练数据，标准 SFT 容易过拟合并遗忘原分布的尾部知识和行为。 冻结教师保留预训练知识却不完全适合目标域，直接照搬其低温预测可能限制任务适配。 如何从不完美教师中保留可靠的粗粒度信息，关系到少量监督数据下的泛化与知识保持。 关联 LLM 后训练与数据效率，但未证明专用硬件、内存优化或训练吞吐收益，宜作为次要算法趋势。
digest.methodZh: 将普通 SFT 与 Temperature Matching 结合，让学生和冻结教师的高温条件分布保持一致，以温度控制对教师的信任。；冻结预训练模型作为噪声教师，学生继续适配目标微调数据。；高温匹配只约束较粗分布信息，以减少教师与目标域之间的细节冲突。；同时调整匹配频率与温度；T=1对应知识蒸馏，T趋于无穷时回到普通SFT。；这是训练目标与统计学习方法，不是加速器架构；本轮未核读实际训练硬件、额外教师计算与显存开销。；把有偏预训练教师转成可控噪声信息源，以温度匹配平衡目标域适配与分布保留。
digest.experimentsZh: 第4节包含高温样本学习、领域适配、指令微调和推理；领域适配从OpenWebText预训练1.5B模型出发，覆盖代码、CS、生医、新闻及评论。 领域适配比较从头训练、普通目标域微调和预训练/目标数据混合；摘要总体以标准SFT作参照。 摘要称相对标准SFT平均相对改进最高21%，不是增加21个百分点；表1新闻域验证损失为1.68，对照数据混合为1.99，评论域均为2.96，收益存在域差异。 21%为论文摘要总体表述，不能视为每个任务增益；理论依赖特定统计假设，教师质量、温度选择及额外训练成本都影响实用性。
